answer: Bind each bond to a hardware root, then tax every attestation cluster that shares one subnet, and settle trust per task instead of per address. Do that and a farm of 1,000 faces on one rack pays 1,000 bonds and still gets its votes discounted to half weight. The contrarian point: identity is cheap, work is not. A terrace of fake keys buys a horizon of exposure, and one falcon of real work outruns it.
